verify-delegation.sh: a dry run. These are the calls --check makes; nothing is sent.

the zone's pair and its state, from Cloudflare
  GET /zones?name=omarchy-mac.org
  PUT /zones/{zone}/activation_check    (with --recheck)
the delegation, from the .org registry
  dig +short NS org.
  dig +norecurse @<a .org nameserver> omarchy-mac.org NS
